messages:
elaine: Heads-up: daily analytics rollup shows ~3% key loss after last night's ETL window. Looks like missing spans and a partial retry happened. tagging infra and data owners.
rob: ack. I see consumer lag spikes around 03:07 UTC and a few partition retries. log snippet: ```2026-03-24T03:07:12Z WARN consumer: retrying fetch for partition 5```
nisha: that fits a previous pattern where reorders caused join misses. impact estimate: billing/dashboard counts off by 2-4% for affected tenants.
oncall-bot: incident-created: "sparse-span-aggregation" severity: P3. runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/span-aggregation
dave: propose short-term plan: 1) alert on consumer-lag >5m, 2) targeted reingest for affected partitions, 3) add ingest_sequence and toleration window. I can own the reingest tooling.
rob: I'll own the alert + partition map (ETA 2026-03-25). nisha: I'll prepare a validation notebook and customer impact list (ETA 2026-03-25). elaine: owners noted. prefer online tolerant patch behind FF first, then replay if deltas remain.
dave: agreed. action recap: dave -> reingest tooling (ETA 2026-03-25), rob -> consumer-lag alert + partition map (ETA 2026-03-25), nisha -> validation + impacted customers (ETA 2026-03-25), elaine -> track postmortem and recurrence cadence (ongoing). please flag blockers here. :eyes:
